currentState.publicBlockListingReason: The current Path1 public worksheet binding already contains P1-04 and the public controller populates the selector from the complete block list. This milestone therefore does not need to add P1-04 to the block selector; it only governs practice-mode availability and dispatch.

cutoverDecision.crossBlockModeCarryover: P1-03 <-> P1-04 may retain multiplicativeModelingTransfer because both blocks support the exact same public mode id. Carrying equalGroupsTransfer into P1-03/P1-04 or carrying multiplicativeModelingTransfer into unsupported blocks must normalize to arithmetic with a warning; do not auto-convert between modeling mode ids.

publicMetadataProjection.reason: The public wrapper is responsible for route-level cutover metadata. It must not stamp the P1-03 gate identity on P1-04 merely because both blocks share the same practiceMode string.

requiredChanges.action: Import the existing dedicated P1-04 modeling worksheet adapter. Keep multiplicativeModelingTransfer as one public mode, dispatch P1-03 to the existing P1-03 adapter and P1-04 to the P1-04 adapter, fail closed for every other block, and project a distinct P1-04 public cutover gate id at configSnapshot metadata level without mutating generated-item semantics.

Extend multiplicativeModelingTransfer support from P1-03 only to P1-03 and P1-04 while preserving equalGroupsTransfer support only at P1-01/P1-02. Preserve arithmetic as universal fallback. Existing exports may be retained as compatibility aliases; any new generic helper/warning wording must not weaken unsupported block/mode normalization.

Show/enable the multiplicativeModelingTransfer option for both P1-03 and P1-04, preserve the same user-facing label 文字建模練習, generalize warning text so it is not P1-03-only, preserve explicit mode identity, and allow P1-03 <-> P1-04 navigation to retain the mode while unsupported destinations normalize to arithmetic.

Keep the single multiplicativeModelingTransfer option and update help text to state that P1-03 and P1-04 use their own bounded multiplicative modeling adapters. Do not add a duplicate P1-04 practice-mode option.
